description_en: You can create authorization rules to authorize multiple users to manage assets. You can also specify a validity period for an authorization rule. This way, you can manage users and assets in a more efficient manner and limit the time periods during which users can access assets
description_zh: 通过创建授权规则，按需求为多个用户批量授权资产，以及设置这些用户访问资产的有效期。授权规则功能不仅可以提升管理用户和资产的效率，还可以对用户访问资产的时间加以控制
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-rule --instance-id bastionhost-cn-5yd2ymfsa0e --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-name rule --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRule

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

parameters.help_en: The name of the authorization rule. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则名称。最大128字符

parameters.help_zh: 授权规则备注。最大500字符

parameters.help_en: The start time of the validity period of the authorization rule. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effective_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the validity period of the authorization rule. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 授权规则有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）
